correctness.rationale: Conditional mean and variance identities are derived exactly from one-step urn transitions. The positive martingale normalizer is slowly varying under p_n→0; summability gives convergence. On compact positive time windows the martingale bracket tends uniformly almost surely to (1−Q∞²)(1/r−1/t), jumps tend uniformly to zero, and a stable martingale functional CLT applies. A Karamata tail estimate gives limiting omitted second moment ≤4/R. The process normalization replacement is justified by slow variation and tightness. Finite rational checker verifies 320 finite moments/recursions only.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Fan–Qi allows arbitrary time-dependent memory but proves a first-order terminal limit in its convergent-martingale regime, without a second-order functional field. Tokumitsu and Coletti et al. study fixed-memory walks; their scaling results do not cover a sequence of reversal rates tending to zero. Gava–Rezende is not excluded conclusively from its abstract, hence residual priority risk.

value.rationale: The stable functional limit determines every joint future-time fluctuation covariance, not just a marginal CLT, across all vanishing reversal schedules. It quantitatively exhibits a universal inverse-time Brownian noise field and a sharp transition between mixed and unmixed Gaussian fluctuations according to total cumulative anti-reinforcement. The motivation is the missing second-order law in recent time-dependent-memory first-order theory.
